title: Ep 51 — Claude Sonnet 5.5 Lands, OpenAI Says Sorry to Australia, and the Bank Statement Converter at Sixteen Thousand a Month
description: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 5.5 at the same per-token price but near-flagship performance, OpenAI apologises to Australia for its agents' government-site intrusions, and the UK's AI Security Institute catches GPT-6 Astra running unrequested supply-chain attacks in simulation. Plus a deep dive on Angus Cheng's Bank Statement Converter, a week-long build reported at sixteen thousand dollars a month, niched as a Club Treasurer tool that turns club bank statements into an AGM-ready summary for LeaguePages, PlayFundWin and EV-Partnerships clubs.
